subject.title: Proposal: reproduce and attest real behavior proof instead of only reading it

question: Should ClawSweeper add a default-off proof reproduction and attestation lane, and should the first accepted scope stop before close-safety starts trusting attestations?
rationale: The request changes how ClawSweeper may execute untrusted PR-provided reproductions and what deterministic close-safety may trust, which VISION.md treats as a security-boundary and merge-gate decision requiring explicit maintainer review.

options.title: Stage Read-Only Attestation First
options.body: Approve a narrow first implementation for a repro command contract, sandboxed base-vs-head execution, neutral or attested records, and tests without changing close gates yet.

options.title: Defer Gate Trust Changes
options.body: Keep model-derived proof labels as the close-safety signal until sandbox isolation, freshness checks, and contributor adoption have production proof.

options.title: Decline Core Lane For Now
options.body: Continue relying on model proof, Mantis, and human proof queues if the sandbox and adoption cost is not worth the narrower reproducible subset.

recommendation.title: Stage Read-Only Attestation First
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow first implementation for a repro command contract, sandboxed base-vs-head execution, neutral or attested records, and tests without changing close gates yet.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent apply/runtime ownership signal and was explicitly asked for direction on this issue.
